properties.title: LP NS Thermal Neutron Counting Rate
properties.lri:quality_note: Thermal neutron suppression is sensitive to hydrogen AND to other neutron absorbers (Fe, Ti, Gd, Sm, Cl). Cannot be used as a standalone hydrogen proxy - cross-reference with epithermal neutron map and LP GRS Fe/Ti maps to isolate hydrogen signature. See Feldman et al. 2000a and Maurice et al. 2001a.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Raw INT16 binary (therms.dat) scaled ÷10 via gdal_calc.py to obtain thermal neutron counts/32s as Float32. Binary values are 10× the ASCII count rate values. Counting rate defined as difference between Sn and Cd-covered ³He detector rates per 32 s. Written as COG via gdal_translate with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
